name: User Login
description: Users should be able to log in to the system with a valid username and password.
business_rules: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long
Usernames must be unique and at least 3 characters
Account locks after 5 failed login attempts
Session timeout is 30 minutes of inactivity
Users must accept terms before first login

acceptance_criteria.criteria: User can log in with valid username and password
User cannot log in with invalid password
User cannot log in with non-existent username
User cannot log in with empty username
User cannot log in with empty password
Account locks after 5 failed login attempts
User session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity
acceptance_criteria.expected_message: Session expired. Please log in again.

acceptance_criteria.criteria: User must accept terms and conditions before first login
acceptance_criteria.expected_message: You must accept the terms and conditions
